title: The truth about Bitcoin energy consumption

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know Bitcoin uses more energy than some countries?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Bitcoin’s energy use is a hot topic as it grows faster than ever.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Bitcoin mining uses energy equivalent to a small country’s total consumption.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It relies on proof-of-work, which requires massive computational power.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects miners, energy prices, and the environment in big ways.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Bitcoin’s energy use is real, but solutions are emerging.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how Bitcoin could become greener? Follow for the breakdown.
